{{Quote|Very few people have actually seen the StarCave Nebula. It's breathtaking.|Lando Calrissian|<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>}}
The '''StarCave Nebula''',<ref name="Galaxy Map" /> also known as the '''ThonBoka Nebula''', was a [[nebula]] located in the [[Centrality]] within the [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Appendix" /> that few people had ever seen. It was where [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] had an adventure prior to the [[raid on Kessel]],<ref name="Solo" /> in [[10 BBY]].<ref name="Solo Date">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' establishes that the events of ''Solo: A Star Wars Story'' begin nine [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|founding]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the Empire's founding to [[19 BBY]], meaning the events of ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' can be placed in [[10 BBY]]. Since the [[raid on Kessel]] is depicted in ''Solo'', the event can be dated to 10 BBY.</ref>

{{Neb-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The StarCave Nebula originates in the [[1983]] [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] novel ''[[Lando Calrissian and the Starcave of ThonBoka]]'', where it is known as the ThonBoka, which translates as "StarCave Nebula". The location was introduced into the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] when it was mentioned in the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''.
